title: Deathknell does not fire when Tasty Faefolk dies from lethal damage applied via the sandbox `addDamage` move (Actions > Add Counters path).
expected: counters.ts:62-81 — the `addDamage` reducer calls `performCleanup(...)` directly and discards its `CleanupResult`. `performCleanup` (cleanup/state-based-checks.ts:583-617) moves the lethal unit to trash, clears its damage, and only *returns* `deaths`/`killed`; it never dispatches `die` events itself — that is done by the caller in `runStateMaintenance` (events/dispatcher.ts:175-190 → `dispatchUnitDied`). `counterMoves` is not wrapped in `withPostMoveCleanup` (only movement.ts:24 is), and even if a later `cleanupAndFireDeaths` ran it would find nothing (damage already cleared, unit already in trash). Reproduced with the harness: `scenario().unit(P1,"base","ogn-075-298","fae")` then `p1.do("addDamage",{cardId:"fae",amount:6})` → zone=trash, chain=[], no pendingChoice; the same unit killed by a 6-damage spell puts `{cardId:"fae",triggered:true,type:"ability"}` on the chain.
observed: executeMove('addDamage',{cardId:Faefolk,amount:6}) moved the unit to trash (base [], trash 1) but no chain item / pendingChoice appeared; runePool stayed at 2 runes and hand stayed at 5. The addDamage reducer calls performCleanup() directly (reaps without emitting `die` events), so the withPostMoveCleanup/cleanupAndFireDeaths pass finds nothing left to fire. Killing the same unit with Vengeance (kill effect) DID fire Deathknell correctly, so this is specific to the damage→SBA-death path used by the sandbox move.
